summary: Xtra-Gold Resources Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 12, 2026, furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, management's discussion and analysis, and CEO/CFO certifications for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The report is a routine disclosure of financial results by a foreign private issuer and does not involve any corporate transaction or special situation. The filing contains no announcement of acquisitions, divestitures, strategic reviews, or other event-driven matters, and no deal terms are disclosed. It is a standard periodic report.
